answer: Require each identity to periodically report signed round-trip samples to a rotating set of public beacons. Latency vectors are hard to fake: a thousand sybils hosted in one rack answer from one vantage and their vectors collapse into a single point, while honest identities scatter like trees across an orchard. At the sun's zenith every post casts its own short shadow; stack a thousand posts on one ledge and the shadows pile up. One vantage, one voice.
